channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: The Battle to Save General Donahue From Hegseth’s Army Purge
item.description: Gen. Christopher T. Donahue’s vision for fighting future wars won him powerful supporters around the world. Could they save his career?

item.title: NPR: American Muslims are giving Texas barbecue a halal makeover
item.description: Even as anti-Muslim rhetoric rises in Texas, Muslim pitmasters are winning over diners and reshaping one of the state's most iconic culinary traditions.

item.title: BBC News: US envoys meet Zelensky in Ukraine after meeting Putin in Russia
item.description: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrive in Kyiv, having held talks with Putin in Moscow on Saturday.

item.title: The Guardian: I’m a father of three who studies the impact of artificial intelligence: this is what parents need to know about AI
item.description: A Dr Seuss-style story written in seconds alerted me to the power – and perils – of the technology. But how can children embrace it without forgetting core skills? When I was growing up, my dad and I often talked about a…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Bangladesh protesters demand action over rising costs
item.description: Bangladesh sees its first major protests under PM Tarique Rahman, with thousands marching over rising living costs.

item.title: Ars Technica: German company becomes first in Europe to launch fully commercial orbital rocket
item.description: "We achieved within a few years what had taken the European space industry decades before."

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: Pangram Has Emerged as the Gold Standard of AI Detection. Should You Trust It?
item.description: Meet the AI police who can make or break careers—in publishing and beyond.

item.title: WIRED Science: These Cyborg Cockroaches Could Save Your Life
item.description: The team embedded electrodes into live cockroaches, then outfitted them with cameras and injection devices to deliver medication via remote control.

item.title: WIRED Business: Who Cares if AI Is Conscious—It’s Basically Alive
item.description: While philosophers ponder AI consciousness, the models have ideas of their own.

item.title: The New Yorker: A Political Operative on the Verge of Self-Deportation
item.description: Daysi González, who works to elect Democrats, is gearing up to leave the U.S. as soon as this month. She wants her own party to pay attention.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Your Weekly Horoscopes by Madame Clairevoyant: September 6–September 12
item.description: An astrologically quiet week awaits — at least until Thursday arrives.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: Don’t Mind the Rug, Kids
item.description: A historic townhouse in Gramercy Park gets a makeover for a family of five.
